title: An erased Mapper bridge rejects the wrong runtime type
summary: The compiler-generated bridge casts its input before the typed method increments the entry counter.

subject.system: An erased Mapper bridge rejects the wrong runtime type

change.description: The compiler-generated bridge casts its input before the typed method increments the entry counter.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 5 inputs on each revision. original mismatches were 0 for value, 0 for exception, 0 for entries, 0 for typedAgreement. changed mismatches were 1 for value, 0 for exception, 0 for entries, 0 for typedAgreement.

The emitted erased method has the bridge and synthetic flags. Its checkcast precedes its call to the typed Integer method. The wrong-type input never entered that body. The four admissible inputs also ran through the typed descriptor. See [both class files and their disassembly](records/bytecode.json).
